notes.title: Deep Dive with Darwin in our New Video Series!
notes.notes:
Introducing the first installment of our two-part video series where we take you on a journey to understand real-life octopuses and how they stack up to our protagonist in Darwin's Paradox!

Hold your breath and submerge yourself in a sea of wonder with Ghost, a Giant Pacific octopus at the Aquarium of the Pacific in Southern California. Giant Pacific octopus keeper Brooke Hernandez helps us understand these extraordinary creatures and gives us a closer look at some of their out-of-this-world survival abilities.

Wishlist Darwin's Paradox! today.
